root_cause_analysis.symptom: curl -fsS https://ollama.pixelated.love/oauth2/sign_in returned HTTP 403 with oauth2-proxy sign-in HTML body
root_cause_analysis.initial_hypothesis: docker healthcheck using 'wget --spider' not guaranteed to exit 0, causing unhealthy status
root_cause_analysis.actual_finding: docker-compose.yml already had correct healthcheck: 'wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4180/ping || exit 1'. Container was already healthy (Status:healthy, FailingStreak:0).
root_cause_analysis.true_root_cause: traefik v3.1 forwardAuth middleware intercepts ALL requests including /oauth2/* paths. oauth2-proxy returns 403 for unauthenticated requests to /oauth2/sign_in when accessed through forwardAuth, creating a chicken-and-egg problem where the sign-in page cannot be accessed to initiate authentication.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Added higher-priority router (ollama-oauth2-direct, priority:100) for PathPrefix('/oauth2') that routes directly to oauth2-proxy service without forwardAuth middleware. This allows /oauth2/sign_in, /oauth2/callback, /oauth2/static/* to reach oauth2-proxy directly, bypassing the auth check that oauth2-proxy itself is supposed to manage.
root_cause_analysis.validation: All VAL-INFRA-011 layers pass: (a) DNS resolves to Cloudflare IPs, (b) /v1/models returns 403 (guarded), (c) /oauth2/sign_in returns 200 with OIDC sign-in HTML, (d) direct ollama access lists both models
